name: sistema-hotel
description: Sistema do Hotel Tropical: hospedagens, caixa e contas

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n servidor,painel -c blue,green "npm run dev -w servidor" "npm run dev -w painel"

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w servidor && npm run typecheck -w painel
